ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from eligible candidates in Standard Form who are willing to work in mission mode for
engagement on a contractual basis for the following posts in the Head Office of the Guwahati Municipal Corporation,
Ganeshguri. Interested candidates are required to submit the duly filled-in Standard Form along with copies of their
CV, educational certificates, experience certificates, and any other relevant documents in a sealed envelope on or
before 22nd February, 2026.
